intro.title: Rare 22 to 42 Mukhi Java Rudraksha
intro.descriptionHtml: We offer a collection of natural and rare 22 to 42 Mukhi Rudraksha beads from Java, Indonesia. These beads are not mentioned in the Puranas, but as they are the tears of Bhagwan Shiva, they are powerful and possess divine qualities. Each of these beads is associated with the power of various deities and offers unique benefits.
